notes: Quick notes to self: this is a compact view — prefer 1 line per service so ops can scan during sync.
Coverage pct is heuristic from last run of smoke tests and live-traffic sampling; treat as ballpark.
Est monthly burn uses sample QPS * averaged token cost; we should attach raw calc sheet if any stakeholder asks.

If a service shows <80% coverage, escalate to on-call + product master for triage before next weekly.
Useful refs: confluence INF-coverage-quickplay for methodology, PLAT-1892 for previous canary results.
